as.sfi_dedup_instructions: Merge candidates only when they represent the same source-visible curriculum item, using the curriculum hierarchy rather than the extraction window alone. Merge repeated Grade labels when they have the same canonical grade value (P1, P2, or P3); if block-derived grade section headings such as '6.2 SYLLABUS UNITS FOR GRADE ONE/P1', '6.3 Mathematics Syllabus for Primary (P2)', or '6.4 Mathematics Syllabus for P3' are present, treat them as duplicate grade context for the corresponding P1/P2/P3 grade rather than separate grade nodes. Merge repeated Topic Area labels within the same Grade when they have the same canonical or normalized topic value; do not require the same Unit context, because Topic Area is a parent of Unit. Merge repeated Sub-Topic Area labels within the same Grade and parent Topic Area when they have the same canonical or normalized sub-topic value; do not require the same Unit context, because Sub-Topic Area is a parent of Unit. Keep Topic Area and Sub-Topic Area labels distinct across different grades or different parent topic areas. Do not merge different Units across grades or across different unit numbers/titles merely because wording repeats. Do not merge Grade Key Competences, Key Unit Competences, or learning objectives across units merely because wording is similar; merge them only when they are exact duplicate fragments caused by page/table continuation or the same source-visible statement repeated in the same hierarchy context. Known source anomaly: P3 Unit 5 'Relationship between length measurements' has a visible Sub-Topic Area 'Length Measurements' but no visible Topic Area header. Do not treat any source-order carryforward of the previous P3 Topic Area 'Numbers and Operations' as reliable evidence for deduplication or hierarchy. Treat this as Measurement context only when an explicit source-repair decision is needed; otherwise preserve the visible sub-topic/unit as separate source-backed candidates. Exact wording repetition across different Units is not by itself a duplicate: Grade Key Competences, Key Unit Competences, and learning objectives must remain separate when they are independently printed in different Unit contexts, even when their descriptions are character-for-character identical. Merge such records only when the evidence shows they are overlap copies, continuation fragments, or duplicate extraction of the same cited source occurrence in the same Unit context. When candidates in one review set cite the same source occurrence but carry different statement types, use the actual table column or source role to select the canonical type. Do not merge independently printed items from different objective columns or different Units merely to reconcile a type disagreement.
as.sfi_extraction_instructions: Extract Academic Standards SFIs only from Section 6 syllabus-unit content. Treat source-visible Grade/P1-P3, Topic Area, Sub-Topic Area, and Unit labels as Standard Grouping SFIs. Treat grade-level key competences, Key Unit Competence statements, and Learning Objectives under Knowledge and Understanding, Skills, and Attitudes and Values as Standard SFIs. Do not extract Content, Learning Activities, Links to other subjects, Assessment criteria, Teaching/learning aids, examples, Number of Periods, front matter, pedagogy, resources, assessment approach, acknowledgements, references, or weekly time allocation as SFIs. Do not infer absent parent labels. Preserve source-visible wording and table row/header evidence. Do not emit Grade SFIs from numbered section headings or section-title context such as '6.2 SYLLABUS UNITS FOR GRADE ONE/P1', '6.3 Mathematics Syllabus for Primary (P2)', '6.4 Mathematics Syllabus for P3', or 'Mathematics units for Primary One/Two/Three'; treat those headings as context only. Emit Grade SFIs only from source-visible unit-table grade header cells such as 'P1 MATHEMATICS', 'P2 Mathematics', and 'P3 Mathematics'. Known source anomaly / repair for Rwanda Lower Primary Mathematics P3 Unit 5: the source PDF table for 'P3 Mathematics UNIT 5: Relationship between length measurements' shows 'SUB-TOPIC AREA: LENGTH MEASUREMENTS' but omits a source-visible Topic Area header. Do not inherit the preceding P3 Topic Area 'Numbers and Operations' for this table. Do not fabricate a source-visible Topic Area SFI from absent text. Extract the visible Sub-Topic Area and Unit normally, and treat their intended parent topic as Measurement only as a documented source-repair/inferred hierarchy decision downstream. The three Learning Objectives columns are independent vertical lists. Do not combine horizontally aligned Knowledge and Understanding, Skills, Attitudes and Values, Content, or Learning Activities cells into one candidate, and do not infer that entries sharing a physical table row form a semantic tuple. When overlapping table windows expose the same source cell more than once, classify that occurrence consistently from its actual source column.
as.sfi_extraction_validation_instructions: Independently validate the draft against the source-visible Academic Standards content in Section 6 and correct every material omission, false positive, misclassification, truncation, or source-location error. Eligible SFI source regions are limited to: (1) the numbered grade-level competence lists under 6.2.1, 6.3.1, and 6.4.1, where each distinct numbered list item is one Grade Key Competence; and (2) the unit tables under 6.2.2, 6.3.2, and 6.4.2. Do not extract SFIs from Section 6.1 explanatory text, the sentence summarizing the number of units, the 6.2/6.3/6.4 or 6.2.1/6.3.1/6.4.1/6.2.2/6.3.2/6.4.2 headings themselves, table-of-contents entries, repeated page headers or footers, or material outside these eligible regions. In each unit table, retain only source-visible candidates for the Grade cell, Topic Area, Sub-Topic Area or SUB-TOPIC label, the complete Unit number and title, the complete Key Unit Competence statement, and each distinct learning objective appearing in the Knowledge and Understanding, Skills, or Attitudes and Values columns. The 'Learning objectives' heading and the three objective-column headings are classification context, not SFIs. Classify objective statements by their actual source column: Knowledge Objective, Skills Objective, or Attitudes and Values Objective. Treat each distinct bullet or separately expressed statement in those columns as its own objective, even when a bullet marker is missing because of table layout. Join text only when it is clearly one statement continued across adjacent cells, rows, or pages; do not merge separate bullets, separate objective columns, or neighboring statements. Remove all candidates derived from Content or Contents, Learning Activities or Learners activities, Links to other subjects, Assessment criteria, Teaching/learning aids, examples, Number of Periods or Periods, lesson-allocation information, pedagogy, resources, acknowledgements, references, weekly time allocation, or generic and broad competences outside the three grade-level competence lists. These excluded fields may contain imperative or outcome-like wording such as 'learners can', but their table or section role makes them non-SFIs. Do not create a Grade SFI from numbered section headings, section-title context, the document title, or the repeated 'Primary 1 - 3' page footer. Grade SFIs must come only from visible unit-table grade cells such as 'P1 MATHEMATICS', 'P2 Mathematics', or 'P3 Mathematics'. Do not treat the grade-level competence heading itself as a Grade Key Competence; only its numbered list items qualify. Do not treat section numbers, list numbers, Unit numbers, or period numbers as statement_code values. Preserve the complete exact source-visible wording, spelling, capitalization, punctuation, and language. Do not silently correct grammar, normalize controlled values, paraphrase, translate, or replace source wording. A Unit candidate must contain the complete visible Unit number and title but must not absorb the Grade cell or period label. A Key Unit Competence or objective must not be truncated at a visual line, cell, row, window, or page break and must not include text from Content, Learning Activities, examples, or other neighboring columns. Verify that every table candidate cites the raw source-visible header and/or body rows that contain its wording; do not use canonical headers, section-path text, or filldown helper values as quoted evidence unless the same wording is also visible in the raw table cells. Do not invent an absent grouping merely to complete the expected hierarchy. For P3 Unit 5, 'Relationship between length measurements', the source-visible table contains 'SUB-TOPIC AREA: LENGTH MEASUREMENTS' but no Topic Area row. Preserve the visible P3 Grade, Sub-Topic Area, complete Unit, Key Unit Competence, and eligible objectives, but do not create or inherit any Topic Area candidate for this table, including 'Numbers and Operations' or 'Measurement'. Any Measurement parent repair belongs only to downstream hierarchy resolution. Treat the three objective columns as independent vertical lists: horizontal alignment does not create a combined objective, a cross-column pair, or a relationship. If an overlapping extraction window repeats the same source cell, the source-facing statement type must remain the type of that cell's actual column. Correct any draft that assigns one source occurrence to a different objective type because of neighboring or horizontally aligned text.
as.sfi_has_child_instructions: Resolve direct hasChild parents using the source hierarchy: StandardsFramework root -> Grade -> Topic Area -> Sub-Topic Area -> Unit. Grade Key Competence attaches to Grade. Key Unit Competence attaches to Unit. Knowledge Objective, Skills Objective, and Attitudes and Values Objective attach to the Key Unit Competence from the same unit. Prefer source-visible table/section context, source order, shared window/segment/table evidence, and canonical controlled values and nearby source-context evidence. Do not choose parents by repeated text or unit number alone. Use an unresolved root fallback only when no supplied SFI parent is source-supported. Source-repair exception: for P3 Unit 5 'Relationship between length measurements', the PDF omits the Topic Area header even though the visible sub-topic is Length Measurements. Do not attach this Sub-Topic Area or Unit under Numbers and Operations merely because that was the previous source-visible Topic Area. If a P3 Measurement Topic Area candidate is available, use it as the parent for this Length Measurements sub-topic; otherwise use the unresolved root fallback rather than a source-unsupported Numbers and Operations parent. The Knowledge and Understanding, Skills, and Attitudes and Values columns are independent lists. Horizontal table-row alignment across those columns is not parentage evidence; each objective attaches to the Key Unit Competence from its own Unit.

Do not use for numbered section headings such as '6.2 SYLLABUS UNITS FOR GRADE ONE/P1', '6.3 Mathematics Syllabus for Primary (P2)', '6.4 Mathematics Syllabus for P3', or 'Mathematics units for Primary One/Two/Three'; those headings are context only.
